title: Piercing Frame Duo #016 (얼굴 컷 · [일반·P25 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 아마갸루] ; [일반·P8 집중형·얼굴만·메이크업 야미카와])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. TWO women side by side, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the base of their necks and the tops of their collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Every face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge mixed-metal stud hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, three smaller mixed-metal rings, two thick mixed-metal bars and a small mixed-metal stud up to the top; one small mixed-metal stud sits in the right ear; four thin mixed-metal bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small mixed-metal rings pass through the left nostril and a thick mixed-metal septum ring hangs below the nose; a mixed-metal hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a mixed-metal snake-bite ring beside it and a small mixed-metal ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a mixed-metal Medusa stud sits above the lips; a mixed-metal labret stud and a small mixed-metal ring sit on the chin; three small mixed-metal studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge copper hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide copper ear cuff, two smaller copper rings and a small copper stud at the top; two thin copper bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small copper ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small diamonds set into the metal.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
